description:
Adds a configurable platform-free railway station for reversing trains. Build one to eight parallel tracks with adjustable length and spacing, making it suitable for switchback railways, zigzags, and compact reversing points. Passenger and cargo loading can be enabled independently, with adjustable passenger capacity and catchment radius, while the station remains visually track-only. Choose between no cost, selected-track cost, equivalent vanilla track-module cost, or track-module cost plus any enabled passenger and cargo platform modules.
